descripcion: Health centre, hospital, emergency department, pharmacy, dentist and rehabilitation: waiting rooms, consulting rooms, wards, corridors with trolleys and wheelchairs, and the equipment that makes sounds.

bancada_espera.descripcion: Perforated metal seats joined on a beam, against the wall. Cold and hard; the armrests at the ends help you count the places.
bancada_espera.imagen: Footprint of “Health centre beam seating”: a rectangle, 1.70 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

silla_alta_cadera.descripcion: Chair with a higher seat than usual and firm arms, for people who cannot bend at the hip. You sit almost standing.
silla_alta_cadera.imagen: Footprint of “High-seat hip chair”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Sa”.

mostrador_admision.descripcion: Long appointments desk, standing height with a lower, recessed section for wheelchairs. There is usually a glass screen on top with a gap to talk through.
mostrador_admision.imagen: Footprint of “Patient reception desk”: a rectangle with a recess at the front: the low section, where a wheelchair fits, 2.40 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

linea_confidencialidad.descripcion: Raised adhesive strip on the floor, a couple of steps from the counter: wait here until the person ahead has finished. You feel it underfoot and with the cane.
linea_confidencialidad.aviso: Waiting line: wait here for your turn.
linea_confidencialidad.imagen: Footprint of “Privacy waiting line”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Lc”.

quiosco_citas.descripcion: Free-standing machine by the entrance: put your health card in the slot at waist height, it beeps and prints a slip with your queue number.

acciones.san_pedir_cita: Get a queue ticket with your health card

quiosco_citas.imagen: Footprint of “Health card check-in kiosk”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.55 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Qc”.

pantalla_turnos.descripcion: Screen hung from the ceiling or the wall, above head height. Every so often it chimes and announces a number and a room: it helps you locate the waiting room.
pantalla_turnos.imagen: Footprint of “Queue call display”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.12 metres, hanging 1.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pt”.

gel_pared.descripcion: Small plastic box screwed to the wall at chest height, with a lever underneath. It sticks out a hand's width and the cane misses it.
gel_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Wall hand gel dispenser”: a rectangle, 0.12 by 0.12 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Gp”.

gel_pie.descripcion: Thin metal column on a heavy base, with the gel bottle on top and a pedal at the bottom. It usually stands right in the way, by the door.
gel_pie.imagen: Footprint of “Pedal-operated gel stand”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.35 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Gp”.

revistero_pared.descripcion: Wire or acrylic rack hung on the wall, holding leaflets and magazines, from waist to chest. It sticks out and the cane passes under it.
revistero_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Waiting room wall leaflet rack”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.12 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Rp”.

rincon_infantil.descripcion: Low plastic table with small chairs attached and a bead maze on wires, in the paediatric waiting area. Below hip height: easy to trip over.
rincon_infantil.imagen: Footprint of “Waiting room children's corner”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ri”.

tensiometro_espera.descripcion: Station with a seat and, to one side, a sleeve you put your arm into. Press the button and the cuff squeezes, lets the air out and beeps three times.
tensiometro_espera.imagen: Footprint of “Self-service blood pressure station”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Te”.

mesa_consulta.descripcion: The doctor's desk, with the computer on one side and drawers. The patient sits opposite; the couch is usually behind.
mesa_consulta.imagen: Footprint of “Doctor's consulting desk”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

sillas_paciente.descripcion: Two matching chairs side by side in front of the doctor's desk. Light: they shift when you pull them out.
sillas_paciente.imagen: Footprint of “Patient and companion chairs”: a rectangle, 1.15 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Sp”.

taburete_medico.descripcion: Round backless stool on five castors: push it and it rolls away. It stands by the couch or the dental chair.
taburete_medico.imagen: Footprint of “Doctor's rolling stool”: a circle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Tm”.

camilla_exploracion.descripcion: Tall, narrow padded couch on metal legs, covered with paper that crackles. Walk around its sides; there is a gap underneath.
camilla_exploracion.imagen: Footprint of “Examination couch”: a rectangle, 0.65 by 1.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

camilla_ginecologica.descripcion: Examination chair with two metal leg rests spreading forward at hip height. The leg rests stick out and the cane passes underneath.
camilla_ginecologica.imagen: Footprint of “Gynaecological chair”: a body at the back and two leg rests spreading towards the front, 0.90 by 1.70 metres, marked with the letters “Cg”.

escalerilla_camilla.descripcion: Two rubber-topped metal steps at the foot of the couch, for climbing on. Low and loose: easy to trip over, and they shift.
escalerilla_camilla.imagen: Footprint of “Two-step couch stool”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ec”.

biombo_clinico.descripcion: Screen of fabric panels on a tubular frame, in a zigzag, hiding the couch. Light: it gives and rolls if you lean on it.
biombo_clinico.imagen: Footprint of “Wheeled medical screen”: a zigzag of three panels, 1.60 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

bascula_tallimetro.descripcion: Low metal platform with a column and a measuring rod rising above head height. The platform rocks a little when you step on it.
bascula_tallimetro.imagen: Footprint of “Scales with height rod”: a rectangle, 0.35 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Bt”.

pesabebes.descripcion: Waist-high cabinet with a curved plastic tray on top, where the baby is laid to be weighed. Drawers underneath.
pesabebes.imagen: Footprint of “Baby scales on a cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

negatoscopio.descripcion: Flat light box hung on the wall at face height, for viewing X-rays. It hums quietly when on. The cane passes under it.
negatoscopio.imagen: Footprint of “Wall X-ray viewer”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.10 metres, hanging 1.30 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ne”.

estacion_diagnostico.descripcion: Panel on the wall above the couch, holding the blood pressure monitor, the otoscope and their coiled cables hanging down. At shoulder height; the cane does not touch it.
estacion_diagnostico.imagen: Footprint of “Wall diagnostic station”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.12 metres, hanging 1.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ed”.

ecografo.descripcion: A machine the size of a tall cart, with a keyboard at waist height and a screen on an arm above. A fan blows when it is on.
ecografo.imagen: Footprint of “Ultrasound machine on wheels”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ec”.

lampara_exploracion.descripcion: Wheeled base and a pole with a flexible arm ending in the lamp head, at head height. The base is detected; the arm is not.
lampara_exploracion.imagen: Footprint of “Examination lamp on an arm”: a rounded base at the back and an arm reaching forward to the lamp head, 0.60 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Le”.

cabina_audiometria.descripcion: Soundproof box the size of a large cupboard, with a thick door and a step at the entrance. Inside you hear nothing from outside.
cabina_audiometria.imagen: Footprint of “Audiometry booth”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

lavamanos_clinico.descripcion: Small basin hung on the wall, with no pedestal and a long elbow-operated tap. There is a gap underneath: the cane gives no warning.
lavamanos_clinico.imagen: Footprint of “Wall-hung clinical basin”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.42 metres, hanging 0.65 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Lc”.

vitrina_material.descripcion: Tall metal cabinet with glass doors and shelves of bandages and bottles. Smooth and cold; the glass rattles when struck.
vitrina_material.imagen: Footprint of “Medical supplies cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Vm”.

carro_curas.descripcion: Steel trolley with two trays and a drawer, at waist height. Bump into it and the instruments rattle and the trolley rolls.
carro_curas.imagen: Footprint of “Dressing trolley”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

frigorifico_vacunas.descripcion: Small metal fridge with a lock, where vaccines and insulin are kept. It hums all the time and the temperature alarm sometimes beeps.
frigorifico_vacunas.imagen: Footprint of “Vaccine fridge”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Fv”.

cama_hospital.descripcion: Tall metal bed on braked wheels, with drop-down side rails and a handset that raises the head end with a whirr. The head goes against the wall.

acciones.san_subir_cabecero: Raise the head of the bed

cama_hospital.imagen: Footprint of “Adjustable hospital bed”: a long rectangle with slightly wider head and foot boards, 1.00 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ch”.

cuna_hospital.descripcion: Wheeled metal cot with high bars, up to an adult's chest. One side drops with a click.
cuna_hospital.imagen: Footprint of “Hospital cot”: a rectangle, 0.75 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ch”.

incubadora.descripcion: Clear plastic dome on a wheeled cabinet, at chest height. It blows warm air and beeps softly with the baby's heartbeat.
incubadora.imagen: Footprint of “Incubator”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.65 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “In”.

mesilla_hospitalaria.descripcion: Wheeled plastic locker by the head of the bed, with a drawer, a door and a fold-up tray on one side. It moves if you lean on it.
mesilla_hospitalaria.imagen: Footprint of “Hospital bedside locker”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Mh”.

mesa_cama.descripcion: Narrow top on a side column with C-shaped feet: the feet slide under the bed and the top hangs over it. The cane goes in under the top.
mesa_cama.imagen: Footprint of “Overbed table”: a C: the column on one side and two wheeled feet that slide under the bed, 0.80 by 0.42 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

sillon_acompanante.descripcion: Vinyl armchair with arms, beside the bed. Reclined, a footrest comes out at the front and it takes up nearly twice the room: its size changes from day to day.
sillon_acompanante.imagen: Footprint of “Reclining visitor's armchair”: a rectangle, 0.75 by 0.85 metres, marked with the letters “Sa”.

armario_habitacion.descripcion: Tall, narrow wardrobe with one or two doors, by the entrance to the room: one per bed. The door opens into the passage.
armario_habitacion.imagen: Footprint of “Hospital room wardrobe”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Ah”.

cortina_cama.descripcion: Curtain hanging from a ceiling track, dividing two beds. Soft: it gives when touched and the rings rattle as you draw it. Drawn back, you can pass.
cortina_cama.imagen: Footprint of “Bed divider curtain”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.08 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

tv_hospital.nombre: Ward television on a wall arm
tv_hospital.descripcion: Television hung on an arm sticking out of the wall, above head height, at the foot of the bed. When on, you hear it from the corridor.
tv_hospital.imagen: Footprint of “Ward television on a wall arm”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.40 metres, hanging 1.70 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Th”.

portasueros.descripcion: Thin metal pole on five wheeled legs, with the drip bags hanging at the top. The cane hits the legs before the pole; it rolls if pushed.
portasueros.imagen: Footprint of “Drip stand on wheels”: a 5-pointed star, 0.55 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Po”.

bomba_infusion.descripcion: A heavy drip stand with one or more boxes at mid height metering the drip. It clicks every second and beeps three times when the bag runs out. A cable runs to the socket.
bomba_infusion.imagen: Footprint of “Infusion pump stand”: a pentagon: five wheeled legs, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Bi”.

monitor_constantes.nombre: Vital signs monitor on a stand
monitor_constantes.descripcion: A screen the size of a shoebox on a wheeled stand, with leads running to the patient. It beeps with every heartbeat: you hear it from the door.
monitor_constantes.imagen: Footprint of “Vital signs monitor on a stand”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

cabecero_tecnico.descripcion: Aluminium trunking across the wall above the bedhead, with sockets, a light, oxygen outlets and the nurse call button. It is at the head height of a standing person.
cabecero_tecnico.imagen: Footprint of “Bedhead services panel”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.12 metres, hanging 1.45 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ct”.

control_enfermeria.descripcion: Large U-shaped counter in the middle of the ward, tall on the outside, with the staff inside. Call bells and phones ring: it is the landmark for finding your way along the corridor.
control_enfermeria.imagen: Footprint of “Nurses' station”: a U open at the back, where the staff go in, 3.50 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

silla_ruedas_abierta.descripcion: An empty, open wheelchair left in the corridor. The footrests stick out at the front, close to the floor, and the handles at the back at waist height. If the brakes are off, it rolls.
silla_ruedas_abierta.imagen: Footprint of “Parked wheelchair”: a wide body at the back, with the large wheels, narrowing at the front to the footrests, 0.65 by 1.05 metres, marked with the letters “Sr”.

silla_ruedas_plegada.descripcion: A closed wheelchair leaning against the wall: a long, narrow bundle of tubes and two large wheels. It tips over if you catch it.
silla_ruedas_plegada.imagen: Footprint of “Folded wheelchair”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 1.05 metres, marked with the letters “Sr”.

sillas_ruedas_prestamo.descripcion: Wheelchairs nested into one another by the hospital entrance, like supermarket trolleys, with a chain and a coin lock.
sillas_ruedas_prestamo.imagen: Footprint of “Row of loan wheelchairs”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Sr”.

andador.descripcion: Light tubular frame on four legs, or on wheels with brakes, open at the back. Left beside a chair or a bed: the cane catches it and it shifts.
andador.imagen: Footprint of “Walking frame”: a thin U open at the back, where the person stands, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “An”.

muletas_pared.descripcion: A pair of aluminium crutches leaning on the wall or a chair, their tips out from the skirting. Brush them and they clatter to the floor.
muletas_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Crutches leaning on the wall”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.30 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

camilla_traslado.descripcion: Tall wheeled trolley with its rails down, parked against the corridor wall. It narrows the way and is in a different place every day.
camilla_traslado.imagen: Footprint of “Transfer trolley in the corridor”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.70 by 2.10 metres, marked with the letters “Ct”.

carro_medicacion.descripcion: Closed trolley of small drawers, one per patient, with a top at chest height. Heavy; it rolls with a rattle of drawers.
carro_medicacion.imagen: Footprint of “Medication trolley”: a rectangle, 0.75 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

carro_lenceria.descripcion: Tall shelved trolley full of folded sheets and towels, covered with a fabric hood. Soft at the sides and taller than a seated person.
carro_lenceria.imagen: Footprint of “Linen trolley”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cl”.

carro_ropa_sucia.descripcion: Wheeled metal hoop with a fabric sack hanging from it and a pedal lid. Light and waist high.
carro_ropa_sucia.imagen: Footprint of “Soiled linen bag trolley”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

carro_comidas.descripcion: Steel cabinet on wheels carrying the meal trays, hot on one side and cold on the other. It hums, smells of food and the metal may be hot.
carro_comidas.imagen: Footprint of “Ward meal trolley”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

carro_limpieza_hospital.descripcion: Plastic trolley with two buckets, a rubbish bag and mop handles sticking out above and to the sides. The floor around it is often wet.
carro_limpieza_hospital.imagen: Footprint of “Hospital cleaning trolley”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Cl”.

carro_paradas.descripcion: Drawer trolley with the defibrillator on top, a hard board at the back and a small cylinder at the side. It is always in the same place, by the nurses' station, and is not to be touched.
carro_paradas.imagen: Footprint of “Crash trolley”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

bombona_oxigeno.descripcion: Heavy, cold steel cylinder standing on a two-wheeled cart. When open, it hisses and bubbles in the humidifier bottle.
bombona_oxigeno.imagen: Footprint of “Oxygen cylinder on its trolley”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Bo”.

contenedor_sanitario.descripcion: Rigid plastic bin with a pedal lid and a lock, for contaminated material. The lid drops with a hollow thud.
contenedor_sanitario.imagen: Footprint of “Clinical waste bin”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Cs”.

lavamanos_quirurgico.descripcion: Long, deep steel trough with two or three tall taps worked by knee or sensor. The water drums on the metal and echoes.
lavamanos_quirurgico.imagen: Footprint of “Surgical scrub sink”: a rectangle, 1.60 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Lq”.

desfibrilador_pared.descripcion: Small cabinet hung on the wall at chest height, with the defibrillator inside. It sticks out a hand's width; opening it sets off a shrill alarm.
desfibrilador_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Defibrillator in a wall cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.20 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Dp”.

pasamanos_pasillo.descripcion: Wide plastic rail along the wall at hip height, which also acts as a bumper against trolleys. Follow it with your hand; it breaks at every door.
pasamanos_pasillo.imagen: Footprint of “Hospital corridor handrail”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.10 metres, hanging 0.80 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pp”.

puerta_vaiven.descripcion: Two wide leaves that push open both ways, with a metal kick plate at the bottom for trolley knocks. They swing back on their own: mind whoever is behind you.
puerta_vaiven.imagen: Footprint of “Hospital swing doors”: a rectangle, 1.60 by 0.08 metres, marked with the letters “Pv”.

mostrador_triaje.descripcion: Low desk-counter for sitting to talk to the nurse who decides the order of entry. The computer is on one side and a chair in front.
mostrador_triaje.imagen: Footprint of “Triage desk”: a rectangle, 1.60 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mt”.

silla_triaje.descripcion: Wipe-clean plastic chair with wide arms, where you sit to have your blood pressure and temperature taken as soon as you arrive.
silla_triaje.imagen: Footprint of “Triage chair”: a rectangle, 0.65 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “St”.

box_cortina.descripcion: A space closed on three sides by curtains hanging from the ceiling, open at the front. A trolley fits inside. The walls are fabric: they give and cannot be leaned on.
box_cortina.imagen: Footprint of “Curtained emergency bay”: a U open at the front, 2.50 by 2.80 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

camilla_observacion.descripcion: Wide trolley with the backrest raised, side rails up and a drip pole at one corner. Higher than a bed: you need help to get on.
camilla_observacion.imagen: Footprint of “Observation trolley”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 2.10 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

sillon_extracciones.descripcion: Chair with two wide padded armrests sticking out to the sides, to stretch your arm out while blood is taken.
sillon_extracciones.imagen: Footprint of “Blood test chair”: a backrest behind and two wide armrests sticking out sideways at the front, 0.90 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Se”.

puesto_dialisis.descripcion: A long reclining chair and, beside its head, a chest-high machine with tubes running to the arm. The pump turns with a regular click and sometimes beeps.
puesto_dialisis.imagen: Footprint of “Haemodialysis station”: an L shape, 1.50 by 1.90 metres, marked with the letters “Pd”.

mesa_rayos.descripcion: Long, hard, cold table at hip height in the middle of the X-ray room. The tube hangs above it. When it fires you hear a rising hum and a beep.
mesa_rayos.imagen: Footprint of “X-ray table”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Mr”.

tubo_rayos_techo.descripcion: Heavy metal head hanging from a ceiling column and moving on rails. It is at head height and the cane does not find it.
tubo_rayos_techo.imagen: Footprint of “Ceiling-mounted X-ray tube”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.60 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tr”.

bucky_mural.descripcion: Metal column against the wall with a flat panel that slides up and down: you stand with your chest pressed against it. A foot sticks out at the base.
bucky_mural.imagen: Footprint of “Wall X-ray stand”: a rectangle, 0.65 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bm”.

mampara_plomada.descripcion: Thick, very heavy panel with a glass window, behind which the radiographer stands. It does not move when pushed and sounds solid.
mampara_plomada.imagen: Footprint of “Lead X-ray screen”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

resonancia.descripcion: A huge machine with a tunnel through the middle and a narrow table coming out at the front. When running it hammers loudly, audible from the corridor. No metal nearby.
resonancia.imagen: Footprint of “MRI scanner”: a T shape, 2.30 by 3.80 metres, marked with the letters “Re”.

mamografo.descripcion: Tall column with a rotating arm and two plates at chest height, one fixed and one that presses. The arm sticks out towards whoever approaches.
mamografo.imagen: Footprint of “Mammography unit”: a narrow column at the back and a wide arm at the front, 0.70 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

mostrador_farmacia.descripcion: Continuous counter at waist height, with small displays on top and the till. The drawer units are behind it. You reach it by crossing the whole shop.
mostrador_farmacia.imagen: Footprint of “Pharmacy counter”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mf”.

puesto_farmacia_isla.descripcion: A free-standing individual counter with rounded corners, one per pharmacist. There are several, set apart, and you can walk round them.
puesto_farmacia_isla.imagen: Footprint of “Island pharmacy service point”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.70 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pf”.

cajoneras_medicamentos.descripcion: Metal columns of long, narrow drawers that pull right out, behind the counter. An open drawer juts into the way at any height.
cajoneras_medicamentos.imagen: Footprint of “Pharmacy drawer units”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

gondola_parafarmacia.descripcion: Low shelving unit with two faces, in the middle of the pharmacy, holding creams and bottles. It reaches chest height: you can talk over it.
gondola_parafarmacia.imagen: Footprint of “Health and beauty gondola”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Gp”.

bascula_farmacia.descripcion: Coin-operated scales with a platform and a tall column from which the height rod comes down to touch your head. It beeps, whirrs and prints a slip; some speak the weight aloud.
bascula_farmacia.imagen: Footprint of “Talking pharmacy scales”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Bf”.

punto_sigre.descripcion: Waist-high cardboard or metal container with an opening on top for dropping in old medicine boxes. It usually stands by the counter.
punto_sigre.imagen: Footprint of “Expired medicines drop-off point”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Ps”.

cruz_farmacia.descripcion: Illuminated cross projecting from the shop front over the pavement. It hums slightly. Low ones are at the head height of a tall person.
cruz_farmacia.imagen: Footprint of “Pharmacy cross sign”: a rectangle, 0.15 by 0.90 metres, hanging 2.30 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cf”.

dispensador_guardia.descripcion: Metal drawer in the shop front at waist height, through which medicines are handed out at night with the door shut. There is a bell beside it and it sticks out a hand's width.
dispensador_guardia.imagen: Footprint of “Pharmacy night hatch”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.25 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Dg”.

sillon_dental.descripcion: A long chair that tilts back, with an instrument arm on one side, the lamp above and the spittoon on the other side. The drill whistles very high when working.
sillon_dental.imagen: Footprint of “Dental chair”: a long chair with an instrument arm on one side and the lamp and spittoon on the other, 1.50 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Sd”.

escupidera_dental.descripcion: Small ceramic bowl on a column beside the chair, with a trickle of water always running and a tap to fill the cup.
escupidera_dental.imagen: Footprint of “Dental spittoon”: a circle, 0.35 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Ed”.

mueble_clinico_dental.descripcion: A run of base units with instrument drawers and a small sink, at waist height, against the wall behind the chair.
mueble_clinico_dental.imagen: Footprint of “Dental surgery cabinetry”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

rayos_pared_dental.descripcion: Jointed arm fixed to the wall, with a tube at its end. Folded, it sticks out little; unfolded, it reaches the chair at face height.
rayos_pared_dental.imagen: Footprint of “Dental wall X-ray unit”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 0.50 metres, hanging 1.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Rp”.

ortopantomografo.descripcion: Tall column with an arm that turns around the head: you stand, bite on a piece and grip two handles. The arm is at face height.
ortopantomografo.imagen: Footprint of “Panoramic dental X-ray machine”: a narrow column at the back and a wide arm at the front, 1.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Or”.

paralelas_marcha.descripcion: Two metal bars at hip height, parallel, over a long platform. You enter at one end and walk between them holding both.
paralelas_marcha.imagen: Footprint of “Gait training parallel bars”: a U open at the front, 0.80 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

escalera_rampa.descripcion: Wooden unit with three or four steps on one side, a landing on top and a ramp on the other, all with handrails. For practising going up and down.
escalera_rampa.imagen: Footprint of “Exercise stairs and ramp”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 3.20 metres, marked with the letters “Er”.

platos_equilibrio.descripcion: Wooden disc the size of a manhole cover with a half ball underneath: step on it and it tilts in any direction.
platos_equilibrio.aviso: Balance board: it tilts when you step on it.
platos_equilibrio.imagen: Footprint of “Balance board on the floor”: a circle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

pista_obstaculos_marcha.descripcion: A row of plastic bars and little hurdles a hand high, laid on the floor for learning to lift your feet. You have to step over each one.
pista_obstaculos_marcha.imagen: Footprint of “Gait track with low hurdles”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 0.80 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Po”.

camilla_fisioterapia.descripcion: Wide, well-padded couch with a face hole at one end, raised and lowered by a pedal. It is sometimes very low, at knee height.
camilla_fisioterapia.imagen: Footprint of “Physiotherapy couch”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 1.95 metres, marked with the letters “Cf”.

camilla_bobath.descripcion: Large padded platform, almost square and low, with room for the patient lying down and the physiotherapist kneeling. Soft on top and hard at the edge.
camilla_bobath.imagen: Footprint of “Wide neurological treatment plinth”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

jaula_poleoterapia.descripcion: Cage of metal mesh on three sides and overhead, with a couch inside, from which pulleys, ropes and weights hang. The mesh rattles when touched.
jaula_poleoterapia.imagen: Footprint of “Pulley therapy cage”: a U open at the front, 2.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Jp”.

bicicleta_clinica.descripcion: Fixed bike with a wide saddle, a tall handlebar and a cross-shaped base. Pedal and you hear the flywheel turning with a whoosh.
bicicleta_clinica.imagen: Footprint of “Clinical exercise bike”: a narrow body with a foot bar across the back and the handlebars across the front, 0.60 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

pedalier.descripcion: A pair of pedals on a small tubular frame, on the floor in front of a chair. Low and loose: easy to trip over.
pedalier.imagen: Footprint of “Pedal exerciser”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

rueda_hombro.descripcion: Large metal wheel with a crank handle, fixed to the wall at shoulder height. It sticks out two hands' width and the cane passes under it.
rueda_hombro.imagen: Footprint of “Wall shoulder wheel”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.30 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Rh”.

banco_cuadriceps.descripcion: High seat with a backrest and two weighted lever arms hanging at the front, at shin height. The arms swing if you touch them.
banco_cuadriceps.imagen: Footprint of “Quadriceps bench”: a T shape, 1.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

mesa_manos.descripcion: Table with a round cut-out where the patient sits in, and on top boards with pegs, screws, springs and putty for exercising the fingers.
mesa_manos.imagen: Footprint of “Hand therapy table”: a rectangle with a round cut-out at the front, where the patient sits, 1.20 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mm”.

espejo_postura.descripcion: Full-length mirror in a wheeled frame, at the end of the parallel bars. Smooth and cold: to someone with low vision the room seems to go on.
espejo_postura.imagen: Footprint of “Mobile posture mirror”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ep”.

cunas_rulos.descripcion: Covered foam wedges, rolls and cushions piled on the floor. Soft and light: they do no harm, but your foot sinks in and twists.
cunas_rulos.imagen: Footprint of “Physiotherapy wedges and rolls”: an irregular heap, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

pelota_fisioterapia.descripcion: Inflated rubber ball reaching the knee or the thigh. Touch it and it rolls away; it bounces with a hollow sound.
pelota_fisioterapia.imagen: Footprint of “Large physiotherapy ball”: a circle, 0.65 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Pf”.

bano_parafina.descripcion: Lidded metal tank on a small cart, full of hot wax for the hands. The metal is hot and it smells of candles.
bano_parafina.imagen: Footprint of “Paraffin wax bath”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

carro_electroterapia.descripcion: Small trolley with a current or ultrasound device on top and leads hanging over to the couch. It hums while working and beeps three times when the time is up.
carro_electroterapia.imagen: Footprint of “Electrotherapy trolley”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.
